local_review.finding_body: The coordinate's build.gradle hardcoded org.bytedeco:ffmpeg-platform:7.1.1-1.5.12 while the tested org.bytedeco:ffmpeg dependency follows the TCK-resolved library version. Reusing this suite for a newer tested version would pair it with stale native binaries, violating the version-agnostic test requirement in §FS-test-contract.2.5.
local_review.finding_title: Companion runtime dependency is pinned to one library version
local_review.fix_note: Changed the ffmpeg-platform runtime dependency to use $libraryVersion, matching the tested artifact and the existing ByteDeco test-project convention. The exact Forge finalization command then completed successfully with no additional publishable changes.
local_review.review_comment: Reviewed the single-coordinate diff and local evidence. The tests exercise FFmpeg public APIs with assertions, use a separate test package, contain no Native Image skips or build/run flags, and introduce no legacy metadata files. The reported 0/0 dynamic-access result is a valid no-calls case, so the percentage and entry-count mismatch gates do not apply. Forge finalization passed all three test lanes, metadata and style checks, test-only metadata routing, generated-test validation, and refreshed statistics without further publishable changes.
